# Crocus
Crocus is the city of [textlink="Verda" link="Asclepiu"], and the closest thing the sector has to a real one. It is never quite where the last map put it, which says more about the maps than the city.
Its towers hold residents who were born there and do not intend to leave. Its streets have kerbs, street lights, traffic and litter, and its lower floors run down into tunnels under the rock.
## Who holds it
Both the [color=cyan]TSF[/color] and the [color=orange]Vanguard[/color] keep infantry in Crocus, and both keep vendors, consoles and turrets on its streets. During the war, neither had the numbers to take it. Now neither wants to, and the turrets on its streets point at the roads. Marines and Vanguard soldiers buy coffee from the same stall. The old ones pretend not to see each other. The young ones try to share a table.
Outside the city the roads belong to whoever is driving on them. [textlink="Reaver" link="WGLoreReavers"] APCs patrol the highways.
